subject: Transportation Systems
title: Mega Ships
description: A quick win: understand Mega Ships.

hook.text: The largest container ships carry 24,000 boxes. They're longer than the Empire State Building is tall.

buildup.text: Bigger ships mean lower cost per container. The economics push relentlessly toward scale.

discovery.text: An Ultra Large Container Vessel can carry enough goods to fill a train 44 miles long.

twist.text: Mega ships need deep ports, giant cranes, and wide canals. Not every port can handle them.

climax.text: When the Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal in 2021, the world learned how fragile mega-ship logistics can be.

punchline.text: Bigger ships save money—until one gets stuck.

quiz.question: How many containers can the largest modern container ships carry?
